text:
maya: Quick sync request 1: can we add a compact runbook pane for automatic fallback events in the console? Operators should see: reason (short), selected degrade mode, and one recommended next action.
kevin: +1. Minimal elements: 1-line summary, decision_trace link, and a "Replay in sandbox" button. One click to start triage. :mag: 
sam: Include policy_version and sampling_id in the visible header so audits map easily. Also show decision_hash.
gloria: Audit constraints: append-only, include policy_version, operator_id (nullable), and decision_hash. No edits allowed.
aria: UX: show a single sentence like "Timed out (1.9s) -> quiet-degrade" plus an expandable details drawer for full trace and signal values.
kevin: Multi-trigger case: surface primary reason and list secondary triggers. Example: primary=LATENCY (p95), secondaries=[5xx_rate, kv_miss]. Highlight which rule picked the mode.
maya: Also suggest a rollback affordance if the same fallback fires twice within 5m. Gray it until condition met.
sam: Display the exact threshold crossed: "p95 > 1200ms (observed 1900ms)" so product/PM can read it without pulling logs.
aria: Operator actions: [Acknowledge + Quiet Override], [Replay in sandbox], [Pin reason to incident]. Buttons gated by RBAC.
gloria: For forensic exports, audit blob should be compact and parseable: 
```
decision=fallback
primary_cause=LATENCY
cause_value=1900ms (p95)
mode=quiet-degrade
policy_version=v3.4.1
sampling_id=8a3c2f
decision_hash=sha1...
```
kevin: Implementation note: runbook pane calls /internal/fallback/decision/{decision_hash} to fetch full trace. Use short-lived token in response to avoid leaking.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: autofallback-ui/staging deployed at 1769280032 :rocket: 
maya: Plan: sam -> prototype the one-line + drawer and a mock replay; kevin -> add decision API + feature flag; gloria -> spec audit blob + retention. Aim for staging demo next Wed.
sam: I'll do a React mock with sample traces and a sandbox hook. Will post a screenshot.
kevin: I'll add endpoint and a feature flag gate. Will stub the metrics tile showing last 10m p95 and error rate.
gloria: I'll draft audit schema and PR it. Retention: 90 days hot, 365 days cold export.
maya: Small but important: add an "explain" tooltip that maps internal codes to plain English (e.g., KV_CACHE_MISS -> "context cache miss, may increase latency").
aria: Also a tiny inline sparkline of the last 10m p95 above the one-line summary to speed triage.
kevin: noted. I'll add the sparkline dependency to the staging UI.
ops-bot: incident-bot: @oncall notified when fallback percent > 10% of requests for 2m.
maya: Logging size target: keep per-decision under 2kb, link to full logs for deep dive.
sam: Will include mock sample out-of-band logs link in the prototype.
gloria: I'll attach the audit schema PR once drafted.
maya: Thanks all. End of thread.
